pointerEventsNote: Qaphela: Iziganeko zesikhombisi zivaliwe ukuze ukubetha kungazisusi xa uhambisa ngaphezulu
breakpointSizesNote: Ubungakanani buthiywa ngobubanzi, hayi ngesixhobo, ukuze isikali esifanayo sichaze indawo yokujonga (imixholo) okanye ububanzi bento ngokwayo (grid-plate). Iinguqu ze-CSS azinakusetyenziswa ngaphakathi kwemibuzo yemidiya, ngoko ngenisa amanani:
layoutWidthAliasesNote: Imixholo ichaza imimandla yayo ngamagama athi {contentWidth}, {sidebarWidth}, {containerWidth} kunye no-{layoutGutter}. Izinto zegridi zisebenzisa u-{gridGap} no-{gridItemSpacing}.
availableFunctionalColorsPolaris: Imibala Esebenzayo Ekhoyo evela kuMxholo we-Polaris
palettePickerIntro: Umzekelo wokuqala wendawo eqhutywa yirejista yeesetingi zenkangeleko ye-HAX, usebenzisa imodeli yedatha yephalethi efanayo ne-DDD.
themePaletteDescription: Khetha iphalethi; eli xabiso libhalwa njengophawu lwe-data-palette kumda womxholo.
darkContextDescription: Umboniso wokufundeka nemeko ekhethiweyo kwinkangeleko yemo emnyama.
spacingSides: Amacala: Phezulu (t), Ekunene (r), Ezantsi (b), Ekhohlo (l), X (x), Y (y)
letterSpacingVariableNote: Uguquko lwe-CSS luyafana negama leklasi, linesimaphambili esithi '--ddd-'
richTextHeading: Ufomatho lombhalo otyebileyo neminye imiboniso yedatha
blockCodeExample: Nanku umzekelo webhloko yekhowudi eyodwa, usebenzisa iklasi ethi 'block-code', iphindaphindiwe, kodwa iphepha igama leklasi eliqhelekileyo elithi 'block'
highlightExampleText: Nantsi inguqulelo ende kakhulu yoMbhalo Oqaqambisiweyo edlula esiphelweni sebhokisi yomda
underlineWays: Kukho iindlela ezi-2 zokufumana isitayile sokukrwelela ngezantsi
defaultHrLine: Umgca othe tyaba ongagqibekanga usebenzisa i-hr element
hrDataPrimaryNote: Izinto ze-hr zikwamkela amaxabiso e-data-primary, kwaye zenzelwe ukusebenza kakuhle xa zibekwe ngaphakathi kwento yentloko
hrFitContentNote: Xa zidityaniswe ne-width: fit-content kwintloko ngokwayo, zinokunciphisa ukukrwelela ngezantsi kube ngumbhalo kanye
variableLengthDesignTreatment: Okanye, ukuba ufuna ubude obutshintshayo, sebenzisa i-design-treatment:
accentContrastNote: Qaphela: Umbala wogxininiso awuyi kusetyenziswa ukuba umbala oyintloko awuhlangabezani neemfuno zomahluko
haxCapabilityGap: Isikhewu sokukwazi i-HAX: {components} ayikwazi ukusebenza ne-HAX. Le patheni ibhaliwe kodwa ayipapashwanga kumgca wokufaka de kwenziwe unxibelelwano.
internalContractsIntro: Izivumelwano ezinqumla yonke into zangaphakathi kwezinto (izihloko, iingcaciso ezigqamileyo, ezisongekayo, ezifakiweyo, iiseti zeendawo zolawulo). Ezi zezo zivavanywa sisakhono se-hax-pattern-library-audit; ukunyanzeliswa ngobuninzi kwi-ecosystem yonke ngumsebenzi wamva.
